correctness.rationale: Polar substitution t=|z|² in the normalized Gaussian plane and angular orthogonality give the stated diagonal eigenvalues. Integration by parts gives Δλ_j=[a^j e^(−a)−(a+L)^j e^(−a−L)]/j!, which is negative for every j at a=0 and for a>0 changes sign at most once from positive to negative as j increases. The minimum of a consecutive band is therefore an endpoint. The endpoint ratio is E[(a+S)^N]/N! for S with density e^(−s)/(1−e^(−L)) on [0,L]; it starts below one and increases strictly to infinity. At c_N=L/(e^(L/N)−1) all adjacent differences except the last are positive, and the last is zero, so the unique crossing is before c_N for N≥2 and at c_N for N=1. The last mode increases strictly up to c_N and the vacuum decreases strictly, proving unique optimal placement. At equal endpoints the sign pattern forces every interior eigenvalue strictly higher, even when adjacent modes share the peak. The integer Gamma integral gives the polynomial crossing equation. For fixed L, bounding S gives (N!)^(1/N)−L≤a_N≤(N!)^(1/N); Stirling and bounded convergence now give E[(1+S/a_N)^N]→J(L), the stated additive radius expansion, and the sharp energy equivalent. At fixed N, expansion of the same moment near (N!)^(1/N) yields −E[S]=−L/2+O_N(L²) as the first correction.
residual_risks: The optimizing variable is the squared inner radius; the design is one concentric annulus. Neither the argument nor the supplied numerical checks establish uniformity for L growing with N or optimality over other mask families. The supplied checker was not executed.

value.rationale: The maximin design question itself is useful: a least eigenvalue quantifies worst-case energy capture in a finite band. But the submitted contribution repeats a complete solution of that same useful question. After accounting for the equivalent theorem and the covered N=1 case, the polynomial restatement is an incomplete-Gamma evaluation and the fixed-N thin-width shift is the immediate midpoint term of a Taylor expansion of the same root; no separate motivated new design gap or substantive extension is established by those additions.
residual_risks: This assessment does not diminish the value of having the maximin theorem itself. It evaluates the increment in this frozen submission; no repaired claim was proposed or certified.
